--Master Key 
CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = ''

--Credintial
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL naiyacreds
WITH
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';

--Create External Data Source
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source
WITH(
    LOCATION = 'https://extsynapsestorage.dfs.core.windows.net/raw',
    CREDENTIAL=naiyacreds
)

--Craete External File Format
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT csv_format
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS (
        FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
        STRING_DELIMITER = '"',
        FIRST_ROW = 1
    )
);

--For PARQUET FILE
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_format
WITH(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.GzipCodec'
)



--Openrowset Function
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
)
WITH (
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Units_Sold INT,
    Revenue BIGINT
) AS rows;

-- DROP EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_ext_table
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_ext_table(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Units_Sold BIGINT,
    Revenue BIGINT
)
WITH(
    LOCATION = 'revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = csv_format
)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM revenue_ext_table; --1857
SELECT * FROM revenue_ext_table;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_cetas
WITH(
    LOCATION = 'cetas_revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'revenue/*.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
)
WITH (
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Units_Sold INT,
    Revenue BIGINT
) AS rows;

CREATE VIEW revenue_view
AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'revenue/*.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
)
WITH (
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Units_Sold INT,
    Revenue BIGINT
) AS rows;

--SELECT * FROM revenue_view
SELECT * FROM revenue_cetas
